entries.title: Try Advanced architecture: a map of your project and what a change moves on it
entries.body: Settings › Runbooks now lists Advanced architecture, an experiment that starts off. Turn it on, ask the first mate to map a project, and a crewmate opens a pull request with map files of the project's parts, how they link and the state machines inside them. Then ask what changed since a date, a release or a commit: a card draws the map with every box, link, state and move tagged added, removed or changed, and you go in and out of each part with a click or the keyboard.

picture.alt: A card draws a crewmate's turn as a state machine, with its new states tagged added and its renamed states tagged changed
